//: Typechecks the trees `tsc --build` cannot: test files and the tools/ scripts.
They import engine sources by explicit .ts path so bun runs them without a prior build,
which needs allowImportingTsExtensions, which needs noEmit, which is incompatible with the
composite projects in the solution file. So they get their own no-emit pass instead of
going unchecked — the harness under test/support is real code and deserves a compiler.
